en.joke: My phone's battery life is directly proportional to the number of 'quick sync' meetings on my calendar.
en.explanation: It highlights the relatable modern irony of remote work where 'quick syncs' often drain device battery and personal energy.

people.name: Zoltán Stieber
people.extract: Zoltán Stieber is a Hungarian professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder. Having spent time in a number of Hungarian youth sides Stieber spent four years with the academy of Premier League side Aston Villa before moving to Germany where he worked his way up the league system. He became a regular international player for the Hungary national team including in their Euro 2016 finals squad.
highlights: Professional footballer, plays as winger or attacking midfielder.
Spent four years with Aston Villa academy.
Played for Hungary in Euro 2016 finals squad.

people.name: Daniel Chodowiecki
people.extract: Daniel Niklaus Chodowiecki was a German painter and printmaker of Huguenot and Polish ancestry, who is most famous as an etcher. He spent most of his life in Berlin, and became the director of the Berlin Academy of Art.
highlights: Director of the Berlin Academy of Art.

people.name: Kazuyuki Fujita
people.bio: Japanese professional wrestler and MMA fighter (born 1970)
people.extract: Kazuyuki Fujita  is a Japanese professional wrestler, former mixed martial artist and freestyle wrestler, currently signed to Pro Wrestling Noah, where he is a one-time GHC Heavyweight Champion. He has most recently fought in Road FC, but is also known for his work in the PRIDE Fighting Championships, K-1, Rizin Fighting Federation, and World Victory Road.
highlights: Japanese professional wrestler and former mixed martial artist.
One-time GHC Heavyweight Champion in Pro Wrestling Noah.
Known for work in PRIDE, K-1, Rizin.
